For the distinct-child conclusion, evaluate the same hBlock at ⟨c,x⟩ and ⟨d,y⟩ and simplify the block-diagonal entry with the supplied c ≠ d.  In both clauses leave the left side written exactly as Matrix.reindex e.symm e.symm D⁻¹ at the displayed Sigma coordinates.

Its left side is syntactically the exact diagonal expression required by the statement.  On the right, expose B c and rootedChildCapacitySummand G hG w ρ c through controlled change.  Name the provider-local and summand-local Fintype, DecidableEq, deleted-edge DecidableRel, and component-graph DecidableRel witnesses; identify the Fintype witnesses using Fintype.subsingleton and Subsingleton.elim, and identify all decidability witnesses with Subsingleton.elim.  Rewrite only these named witness equalities, unfold only rootedChildCapacitySummand and rootedCapacity, and close the aligned diagonal equality by rfl or simpa.  This preserves all three conclusions, their directions, and the released summand representation without a named M or extra assumptions.

import PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Prelude
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Acyclic
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.Connectivity.Connected
import Mathlib.Combinatorics.SimpleGraph.DeleteEdges
import Mathlib.Data.Fintype.EquivFin
import Mathlib.Data.Matrix.Block
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Defs
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.NonsingularInverse
import PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.IsAdmissibleRootedTree
import PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.rootedChildCapacitySummand
import PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.rootedChildComponent
import PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.rootedChildComponentsEquivNonroot
import PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.rootedChildRoot
import PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.rootedChildren
import PositiveDefiniteTreeLattice.Main.RootedCapacity.Defs.rootedGram
-- lean-constellation: managed-imports-end

-- lean-constellation: declaration-source-begin

/--
# lean-constellation target: `rootedNonroot_inverse_childBlocks_of_child_admissible`

Let V be a finite type with decidable equality, let G : SimpleGraph V have decidable adjacency and
let hG : G.IsTree. Fix w : V → ℤ and a root ρ : V. Put R := {v : V // v ≠ ρ}, I := {c : V // c ∈
rootedChildren G hG ρ ρ}, C c := rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1, and S := Σ c : I, C c. For every c :
I, use the shared local instances Fintype.ofFinite (C c) and the established deleted-edge
DecidableRel convention for (C c).toSimpleGraph.Adj. Let e := (rootedChildComponentsEquivNonroot G
hG ρ).symm : R ≃ S, D := (rootedGram G w).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val, and B c := rootedGram
(C c).toSimpleGraph (fun x => w (x : V)).

Assume hChildAdm : ∀ c : I, IsAdmissibleRootedTree (C c).toSimpleGraph (fun x => w (x : V))
(rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1). No ambient assumption IsAdmissibleRootedTree G w ρ is made.

Then the explicitly reindexed inverse is the child block-diagonal inverse:
(Matrix.reindex e.symm e.symm D⁻¹) = Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun c => (B c)⁻¹).

Consequently, for all c : I and x y : C c,
(Matrix.reindex e.symm e.symm D⁻¹) ⟨c, x⟩ ⟨c, y⟩ = (B c)⁻¹ x y;
for all c d : I, x : C c, and y : C d with c ≠ d,
(Matrix.reindex e.symm e.symm D⁻¹) ⟨c, x⟩ ⟨d, y⟩ = 0;
and for every c : I, at p_c := ⟨c, rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1⟩ : S,
(Matrix.reindex e.symm e.symm D⁻¹) p_c p_c = rootedChildCapacitySummand G hG w ρ c.

theorem rootedNonroot_inverse_childBlocks_of_child_admissible {V : Type*} [Fintype V]
    [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.IsTree) (w : V → ℤ)
    (ρ : V) :
    let R := {v : V // v ≠ ρ}
    let I := {c : V // c ∈ rootedChildren G hG ρ ρ}
    let C : I → Type _ := fun c => rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1
    let S := (c : I) × C c
    letI : Fintype R := Fintype.ofFinite R
    letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
    letI : ∀ c : I, Fintype (C c) := fun c => Fintype.ofFinite _
    letI : ∀ c : I,
        DecidableRel (rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1).toSimpleGraph.Adj := fun c => by
      intro x y
      change Decidable ((G.deleteEdges {s(ρ, c.1)}).Adj (x : V) (y : V))
      infer_instance
    let e := rootedChildComponentsEquivNonroot G hG ρ
    let D : Matrix R R ℚ := (rootedGram G w).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val
    let B : ∀ c : I,
        Matrix (rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1) (rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1) ℚ := fun c =>
      rootedGram (rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1).toSimpleGraph (fun x => w (x : V))
    (∀ c : I, IsAdmissibleRootedTree (rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1).toSimpleGraph
      (fun x => w (x : V)) (rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1)) →
      Matrix.reindex e.symm e.symm D⁻¹ = Matrix.blockDiagonal' (fun c => (B c)⁻¹) ∧
      (∀ c : I, ∀ x y : C c,
        (Matrix.reindex e.symm e.symm D⁻¹) ⟨c, x⟩ ⟨c, y⟩ = (B c)⁻¹ x y) ∧
      (∀ c d : I, c ≠ d → ∀ x : C c, ∀ y : C d,
        (Matrix.reindex e.symm e.symm D⁻¹) ⟨c, x⟩ ⟨d, y⟩ = 0) ∧
      ∀ c : I,
        (Matrix.reindex e.symm e.symm D⁻¹)
            ⟨c, rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1⟩ ⟨c, rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1⟩ =
          rootedChildCapacitySummand G hG w ρ c := by
  sorry
